## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Data/source contract impact documented
- [ ] Methodology impact documented or not applicable
- [ ] No credentials, generated raw payloads, or local databases committed

## Business and data impact

Explain changes to indicators, weights, missing-data behavior, scores, or decision interpretation.

## Rollback

Explain how to safely revert the application, data, or methodology change.
